summary: Excellent comprehensive specification providing 50+ TypeScript interfaces covering all game entities (races, technologies, ships, weapons, planets, diplomacy, events, game state). All 4 JSON Schema Draft-07 definitions are valid and parseable. The document covers: 15 core enums, 8 base types, complete race/tech/ship/planet/colony/diplomacy/event schemas, game state management, victory tracking, game constants, difficulty configs, validation rules with bounds, and usage examples. Integration verified: 10 races match LORE.md exactly, 6 tech fields consistent with other specs, weapon categories align with weapons-complete.md. No TODO/TBD placeholders found. File structure recommendation included. The specification is implementation-ready and provides type-safe development foundation.
